messages.text:
I've got the refund/return policy here. Our policy allows change-of-mind returns within 30 days, as long as the item is unused, in its original packaging, with the retail box intact (no shipping labels or tape on it) and all accessories/manuals included. A 20% restocking fee applies, and the cost of the prepaid return label is deducted from your refund. To start one, just email (email hidden) with your order number and reason before sending anything back.

If instead your globe arrived damaged or defective, there's no restocking fee — just email photos within 48 hours and they'll send a replacement or refund free of charge.

Full details here: [Refund & Return Policy](https://replogleglobes.ca/pages/refund-return-policy)

Is this about an order you already have, or just checking before you buy?
